processes:task-pr-retire-transform-ynuyg.plain_language_name: Execute the Close and Gather Its Evidence
processes:task-pr-retire-transform-ynuyg.plain_language_description: With the certificate in hand, the processing custodian works the closure: what is owed is settled, the records and rights are resolved under the rules for how long data may be kept, and the close itself is executed. The close is carried out with the counterparty's confirmation, and the evidence is captured as a record pack ready for confirmation.
processes:task-pr-retire-transform-ynuyg.business_purpose: It exists because an ending that leaves no evidence never proves it happened.
processes:task-pr-retire-transform-ynuyg.practical_context: It opens when the verification certificate clears the pack, and it closes with the record pack produced and custody passed to the confirmation custodian.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in customer relationship management executes the close with the counterparty and gathers the evidence into the record pack.

processes:task-pr-retire-verify-rmv7bq.plain_language_name: Check the Closure Pack Against the Closure Rules
processes:task-pr-retire-verify-rmv7bq.plain_language_description: Before the close is executed, the verification custodian tests the pack against the schedule for how long records are kept, the contract for settling what is owed, and the rules limiting how long data may be stored. Any schedule or contract shortfall is named with its fix.
processes:task-pr-retire-verify-rmv7bq.business_purpose: It exists because a close executed on a defective pack would have to be un-executed, which is rarely possible.
processes:task-pr-retire-verify-rmv7bq.practical_context: It starts once the intake manifest is registered, and it ends with the report issued, deviations remediated, and custody passed to the processing custodian.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian in supplier and partner management tests the closure pack against the retention, settlement, and storage rules.

processes:task-pr-retire-intake-zatdsa.plain_language_description: Planning the close-out opens with its case pack: the plan for the close-out, the inventory of obligations still outstanding, and the register of records and rights to be resolved. The intake custodian logs each item against the closure file so the planning starts accounted for.
processes:task-pr-retire-intake-zatdsa.business_purpose: It exists because a close-out planned from an incomplete inventory leaves obligations behind to resurface.
processes:task-pr-retire-intake-zatdsa.practical_context: It opens when the Retire-stage pack is handed over for the activity, and it closes with the manifest registered and custody passed to the verification custodian.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in customer relationship management logs the end-of-relationship papers into the closure planning file.

Any schedule or contract shortfall is named with its fix.
processes:task-pr-retire-verify-4w8tb5.business_purpose: It exists because a close-out plan that breaches the retention or settlement rules would unwind the whole close.
processes:task-pr-retire-verify-4w8tb5.practical_context: It starts once the intake manifest is registered, and it ends with the report issued, deviations remediated, and custody passed to the processing custodian.

processes:task-pr-retire-transform-tfzf6.plain_language_description: With the certificate in hand, the processing custodian works the closure: what is owed is settled, the records and rights are resolved under the rules for how long data may be kept, and the close itself is executed. Once aligned, the completion confirmation is received by the relationship custodian and by the records custodian, and it is logged.
